title: CARMELLE set to champion OPM's global appeal at Eurovision Asia on Nov. 14
summary: The Philippines’ first-ever “Eurovision Song Contest Asia” bet, CARMELLE, is all set to make her mark on the global stage on November 14 (Saturday) in Bangkok, Thailand.
